title: Browse the extracted song directory
changes: Add a collapsible, paginated song directory with filtering by song or header ID, extracted track counts, bank addresses and direct selection.
Keep duplicate IDs as separate source entries and preserve the existing CGB mute and bank navigation without starting playback.
validation: Synthetic Chrome unit rom-data-viewer-song-catalog-synthetic-gcgft5ld checked paging, filters, duplicate IDs, missing headers, selection and existing audio controls.

Protected local-page unit rom-data-viewer-song-catalog-local-nleo7_qy checked all 640 embedded entries across 26 pages and preserved the data; Docker unit rom-data-viewer-song-catalog-docker-holhf0mc matched Python on synthetic input.
limitations: Track counts cover extracted tracks only. The local check used existing embedded data while the source dataset volume was unavailable; native Windows was not tested.
